dz: 对盖乌斯·韦雷斯腐败案的审判开始,由马库斯·图利乌斯·西塞罗出任检察官并出名的演讲者昆图斯·霍滕修斯出任辩护律师.
de: The trial against Gaius Verres for corruption is opened, with Marcus Tullius Cicero as prosecutor and renowned orator Quintus Hortensius as defending lawyer.

t: 盖乌斯·韦雷斯在辩护律师昆图斯·霍滕修斯弃案后被判犯有腐败罪,认为没有希望.
te: Gaius Verres is found guilty of corruption after his defense lawyer Quintus Hortensius abandons the case as hopeless.
